table inet fw4 { # handle 1
	chain input { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		iif "lo" accept comment "!fw4: Accept traffic from loopback" # handle 3552
		ct state vmap { established : accept, related : accept } comment "!fw4: Handle inbound flows" # handle 3554
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) == syn jump syn_flood comment "!fw4: Rate limit TCP syn packets" # handle 3555
		iifname "br-lan" jump input_lan comment "!fw4: Handle lan IPv4/IPv6 input traffic" # handle 3556
		iifname "eth1" jump input_wan comment "!fw4: Handle wan IPv4/IPv6 input traffic" # handle 3557
		iifname "br-dmz" jump input_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 input traffic" # handle 3558
		iifname "br-mgmtdmz" jump input_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 input traffic" # handle 3559
		iifname "br-prod" jump input_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 input traffic" # handle 3560
		jump handle_reject # handle 3561
	}

	chain forward { # handle 2
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state vmap { established : accept, related : accept } comment "!fw4: Handle forwarded flows" # handle 3563
		iifname "br-lan" jump forward_lan comment "!fw4: Handle lan IPv4/IPv6 forward traffic" # handle 3564
		iifname "eth1" jump forward_wan comment "!fw4: Handle wan IPv4/IPv6 forward traffic" # handle 3565
		iifname "br-dmz" jump forward_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 forward traffic" # handle 3566
		iifname "br-mgmtdmz" jump forward_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 forward traffic" # handle 3567
		iifname "br-prod" jump forward_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 forward traffic" # handle 3568
		jump handle_reject # handle 3569
	}

	chain output { # handle 3
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		oif "lo" accept comment "!fw4: Accept traffic towards loopback" # handle 3570
		ct state vmap { established : accept, related : accept } comment "!fw4: Handle outbound flows" # handle 3572
		oifname "br-lan" jump output_lan comment "!fw4: Handle lan IPv4/IPv6 output traffic" # handle 3573
		oifname "eth1" jump output_wan comment "!fw4: Handle wan IPv4/IPv6 output traffic" # handle 3574
		oifname "br-dmz" jump output_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 output traffic" # handle 3575
		oifname "br-mgmtdmz" jump output_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 output traffic" # handle 3576
		oifname "br-prod" jump output_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 output traffic" # handle 3577
	}

	chain prerouting { # handle 4
		type filter hook prerouting priority filter; policy accept;
		iifname "br-lan" jump helper_lan comment "!fw4: Handle lan IPv4/IPv6 helper assignment" # handle 3578
		iifname "br-dmz" jump helper_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 helper assignment" # handle 3579
		iifname "br-mgmtdmz" jump helper_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 helper assignment" # handle 3580
		iifname "br-prod" jump helper_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 helper assignment" # handle 3581
	}

	chain handle_reject { # handle 5
		meta l4proto tcp reject with tcp reset comment "!fw4: Reject TCP traffic" # handle 3582
		reject comment "!fw4: Reject any other traffic" # handle 3583
	}

	chain syn_flood { # handle 6
		limit rate 25/second burst 50 packets return comment "!fw4: Accept SYN packets below rate-limit" # handle 3584
		drop comment "!fw4: Drop excess packets" # handle 3585
	}

	chain input_lan { # handle 7
		tcp dport 443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Mgmt-LuCI-HTTPS-from-LAN" # handle 3586
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 16 bytes 960 accept comment "!fw4: Mgmt-SSH-from-LAN" # handle 3587
		tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-DNS-from-LAN" # handle 3588
		udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-DNS-from-LAN" # handle 3589
		tcp dport 80 counter packets 2 bytes 104 accept comment "!fw4: Mgmt-LuCI-HTTP-from-LAN" # handle 3590
		udp dport 123 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-NTP-from-LAN" # handle 3591
		meta l4proto { icmp, ipv6-icmp } counter packets 1 bytes 56 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-Ping-from-LAN" # handle 3593
		jump accept_from_lan # handle 3594
	}

	chain output_lan { # handle 8
		jump accept_to_lan # handle 3595
	}

	chain forward_lan { # handle 9
		tcp dport 25 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump reject_to_wan comment "!fw4: Block-LAN-SMTP-Direct" # handle 3596
		tcp dport 6881-6889 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump reject_to_wan comment "!fw4: Block-LAN-Torrent" # handle 3597
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Web" # handle 3599
		tcp dport 587 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Submission" # handle 3600
		tcp dport 993 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-IMAPS" # handle 3601
		tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-DNS-Out" # handle 3602
		udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-DNS-Out" # handle 3603
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-SSH-Out" # handle 3604
		udp dport 123 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-NTP-Out" # handle 3605
		udp dport 1194 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-VPN-Out" # handle 3606
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-DMZ-Web" # handle 3608
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-DMZ-SSH" # handle 3609
		tcp dport { 25, 143, 993 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-DMZ-Mail" # handle 3611
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Prod-SSH" # handle 3612
		tcp dport 3389 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Prod-RDP" # handle 3613
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Prod-Web" # handle 3615
		tcp dport 445 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-Prod-SMB" # handle 3616
		tcp dport { 22, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Allow-LAN-MGMTDMZ-Mgmt" # handle 3618
		udp sport 123 udp dport 123 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Legacy-NTP-Fixed-SrcPort" # handle 3619
		jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Accept lan to wan forwarding" # handle 3620
		jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Accept lan to DMZ forwarding" # handle 3621
		jump accept_to_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Accept lan to MGMT_DMZ forwarding" # handle 3622
		jump drop_to_lan # handle 3623
	}

	chain helper_lan { # handle 10
	}

	chain accept_from_lan { # handle 11
		iifname "br-lan" counter packets 1 bytes 229 accept comment "!fw4: accept lan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3624
	}

	chain accept_to_lan { # handle 12
		oifname "br-lan" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: accept lan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3625
	}

	chain input_wan { # handle 13
		meta nfproto ipv4 udp dport 68 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-DHCP-Renew" # handle 3628
		icmp type echo-request counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-Ping" # handle 3629
		meta nfproto ipv4 meta l4proto igmp counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-IGMP" # handle 3630
		meta nfproto ipv6 udp dport 546 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-DHCPv6" # handle 3631
		ip6 saddr fe80::/10 icmpv6 type . icmpv6 code { mld-listener-query . 0, mld-listener-report . 0, mld-listener-done . 0, mld2-listener-report . 0 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-MLD" # handle 3633
		icmpv6 type { destination-unreachable, time-exceeded, echo-request, echo-reply, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } limit rate 1000/second burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-ICMPv6-Input" # handle 3635
		icmpv6 type . icmpv6 code { packet-too-big . 0, parameter-problem . 0, nd-neighbor-solicit . 0, nd-neighbor-advert . 0, parameter-problem . 1 } limit rate 1000/second burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-ICMPv6-Input" # handle 3637
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-SSH-from-WAN" # handle 3638
		tcp dport 23 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-Telnet-from-WAN" # handle 3639
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port redirections" # handle 3640
		jump reject_from_wan # handle 3641
	}

	chain output_wan { # handle 14
		jump accept_to_wan # handle 3642
	}

	chain forward_wan { # handle 15
		meta l4proto esp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_lan comment "!fw4: Allow-IPSec-ESP" # handle 3643
		icmpv6 type { destination-unreachable, time-exceeded, echo-request, echo-reply } limit rate 1000/second burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-ICMPv6-Forward" # handle 3645
		icmpv6 type . icmpv6 code { packet-too-big . 0, parameter-problem . 0, parameter-problem . 1 } limit rate 1000/second burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-ICMPv6-Forward" # handle 3647
		udp dport 500 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_lan comment "!fw4: Allow-ISAKMP" # handle 3648
		ip daddr 10.10.10.10 tcp dport 80 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Pub-Web-HTTP" # handle 3649
		ip daddr 10.10.10.10 tcp dport 443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Pub-Web-HTTPS" # handle 3650
		ip daddr 10.10.10.20 tcp dport 25 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Pub-Mail-SMTP" # handle 3651
		ip daddr 10.10.10.20 tcp dport { 465, 587 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Pub-Mail-Submission" # handle 3653
		ip daddr 10.10.10.20 tcp dport 993 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Pub-Mail-IMAPS" # handle 3654
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Drop-WAN-to-DMZ-Any" # handle 3655
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_DMZ comment "!fw4: Drop-WAN-to-DMZ-Any" # handle 3656
		ip daddr 192.168.199.3 tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump reject_to_lan comment "!fw4: OnlyIPv4" # handle 3657
		ip daddr 192.168.199.3 udp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump reject_to_lan comment "!fw4: OnlyIPv4" # handle 3658
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port forwards" # handle 3659
		jump reject_to_wan # handle 3660
	}

	chain accept_to_wan { # handle 16
		meta nfproto ipv4 oifname "eth1" ct state invalid counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Prevent NAT leakage" # handle 3661
		oifname "eth1" counter packets 2 bytes 304 accept comment "!fw4: accept wan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3662
	}

	chain reject_from_wan { # handle 17
		iifname "eth1" counter packets 88 bytes 29568 jump handle_reject comment "!fw4: reject wan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3663
	}

	chain reject_to_wan { # handle 18
		oifname "eth1" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump handle_reject comment "!fw4: reject wan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3664
	}

	chain dstnat { # handle 19
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "eth1" jump dstnat_wan comment "!fw4: Handle wan IPv4/IPv6 dstnat traffic" # handle 3722
		iifname "br-dmz" jump dstnat_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 dstnat traffic" # handle 3723
		iifname "br-prod" jump dstnat_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 dstnat traffic" # handle 3724
	}

	chain srcnat { # handle 20
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		oifname "eth1" jump srcnat_wan comment "!fw4: Handle wan IPv4/IPv6 srcnat traffic" # handle 3725
		oifname "br-dmz" jump srcnat_DMZ comment "!fw4: Handle DMZ IPv4/IPv6 srcnat traffic" # handle 3726
		oifname "br-prod" jump srcnat_production comment "!fw4: Handle production IPv4/IPv6 srcnat traffic" # handle 3727
	}

	chain srcnat_wan { # handle 21
		meta l4proto tcp ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 counter packets 0 bytes 0 snat ip to 192.168.199.222 comment "!fw4: SNAT-DMZ-Egress" # handle 3734
		ip saddr 10.10.30.0/24 counter packets 0 bytes 0 masquerade comment "!fw4: MASQ-Production-Out" # handle 3735
		ip saddr 10.10.20.0/24 ip daddr 10.0.0.0/8 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: No-NAT-MGMTDMZ-Internal" # handle 3736
		meta nfproto ipv4 masquerade comment "!fw4: Masquerade IPv4 wan traffic" # handle 3737
	}

	chain raw_prerouting { # handle 22
		type filter hook prerouting priority raw; policy accept;
	}

	chain raw_output { # handle 23
		type filter hook output priority raw; policy accept;
	}

	chain mangle_prerouting { # handle 24
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain mangle_postrouting { # handle 25
		type filter hook postrouting priority mangle; policy accept;
		oifname "eth1" tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst) == syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu comment "!fw4: Zone wan IPv4/IPv6 egress MTU fixing" # handle 3738
	}

	chain mangle_input { # handle 26
		type filter hook input priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain mangle_output { # handle 27
		type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain mangle_forward { # handle 28
		type filter hook forward priority mangle; policy accept;
		iifname "br-lan" oifname "eth1" udp dport { 5060, 5061 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 meta mark set 0x00000010 comment "!fw4: Mark-VOIP-Priority" # handle 3740
		iifname "eth1" tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst) == syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu comment "!fw4: Zone wan IPv4/IPv6 ingress MTU fixing" # handle 3741
	}

	chain drop_to_wan { # handle 294
		oifname "eth1" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop wan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3665
	}

	chain input_DMZ { # handle 295
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-Mgmt-from-DMZ" # handle 3666
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-Mgmt-from-DMZ" # handle 3667
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port redirections" # handle 3668
		jump drop_from_DMZ # handle 3669
	}

	chain output_DMZ { # handle 296
		jump accept_to_DMZ # handle 3670
	}

	chain forward_DMZ { # handle 297
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-DMZ-Updates" # handle 3672
		tcp dport 25 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-DMZ-SMTP-Out" # handle 3673
		udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-DMZ-DNS-Out" # handle 3674
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-DMZ-Any-Out" # handle 3675
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-DMZ-Any-Out" # handle 3676
		ip daddr 10.10.30.50 tcp dport 3306 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-DMZ-Prod-MySQL" # handle 3677
		tcp dport { 389, 636 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-DMZ-Prod-LDAP" # handle 3679
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_production comment "!fw4: Drop-DMZ-Prod-Any" # handle 3680
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_production comment "!fw4: Drop-DMZ-Prod-Any" # handle 3681
		tcp dport 1433 limit rate 10/minute burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump reject_to_production comment "!fw4: Log-DMZ-Denied" # handle 3682
		jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Accept DMZ to wan forwarding" # handle 3683
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port forwards" # handle 3684
		jump drop_to_DMZ # handle 3685
	}

	chain helper_DMZ { # handle 298
	}

	chain accept_to_DMZ { # handle 299
		oifname "br-dmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: accept DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3686
	}

	chain drop_from_DMZ { # handle 300
		iifname "br-dmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3687
	}

	chain drop_to_DMZ { # handle 301
		oifname "br-dmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3688
	}

	chain input_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 302
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-Mgmt-from-MGMT_DMZ" # handle 3689
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: Drop-Mgmt-from-MGMT_DMZ" # handle 3690
		jump drop_from_MGMT_DMZ # handle 3691
	}

	chain output_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 303
		jump accept_to_MGMT_DMZ # handle 3692
	}

	chain forward_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 304
		udp dport 514 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-MGMTDMZ-Prod-Syslog" # handle 3693
		udp dport 161 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_production comment "!fw4: Allow-MGMTDMZ-Prod-SNMP" # handle 3694
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-MGMTDMZ-Updates" # handle 3696
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-MGMTDMZ-Any-Out" # handle 3697
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-MGMTDMZ-Any-Out" # handle 3698
		jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Accept MGMT_DMZ to wan forwarding" # handle 3699
		jump drop_to_MGMT_DMZ # handle 3700
	}

	chain helper_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 305
	}

	chain accept_to_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 306
		oifname "br-mgmtdmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: accept MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3701
	}

	chain drop_from_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 307
		iifname "br-mgmtdmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3702
	}

	chain drop_to_MGMT_DMZ { # handle 308
		oifname "br-mgmtdmz" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop MGMT_DMZ IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3703
	}

	chain input_production { # handle 309
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Mgmt-SSH-from-Production" # handle 3704
		udp dport 161 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: Allow-SNMP-from-Production" # handle 3705
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port redirections" # handle 3706
		jump reject_from_production # handle 3707
	}

	chain output_production { # handle 310
		jump accept_to_production # handle 3708
	}

	chain forward_production { # handle 311
		tcp dport 9100 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_MGMT_DMZ comment "!fw4: Allow-Prod-MGMTDMZ-Metrics" # handle 3709
		ip saddr 10.10.10.10 tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-Prod-Updates" # handle 3711
		udp dport 123 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Allow-Prod-NTP" # handle 3712
		meta l4proto tcp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-Prod-Any-Out" # handle 3713
		meta l4proto udp counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump drop_to_wan comment "!fw4: Drop-Prod-Any-Out" # handle 3714
		jump accept_to_wan comment "!fw4: Accept production to wan forwarding" # handle 3715
		ct status dnat accept comment "!fw4: Accept port forwards" # handle 3716
		jump drop_to_production # handle 3717
	}

	chain helper_production { # handle 312
	}

	chain accept_to_production { # handle 313
		oifname "br-prod" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "!fw4: accept production IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3718
	}

	chain reject_from_production { # handle 314
		iifname "br-prod" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump handle_reject comment "!fw4: reject production IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3719
	}

	chain drop_to_production { # handle 315
		oifname "br-prod" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop production IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3721
	}

	chain dstnat_wan { # handle 316
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 80 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.10.10:80 comment "!fw4: DNAT-Web-HTTP" # handle 3728
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.10.10:443 comment "!fw4: DNAT-Web-HTTPS" # handle 3729
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 25 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.10.20:25 comment "!fw4: DNAT-Mail-SMTP" # handle 3730
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 587 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.10.20:587 comment "!fw4: DNAT-Mail-Submit" # handle 3731
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 2222 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.30.5:22 comment "!fw4: DNAT-SSH-Jumphost" # handle 3732
		meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 33890 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat ip to 10.10.30.60:3389 comment "!fw4: DNAT-RDP-Terminal" # handle 3733
	}

	chain dstnat_DMZ { # handle 317
	}

	chain srcnat_DMZ { # handle 318
	}

	chain dstnat_production { # handle 319
	}

	chain srcnat_production { # handle 320
	}

	chain reject_to_production { # handle 1662
		oifname "br-prod" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump handle_reject comment "!fw4: reject production IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3720
	}

	chain reject_to_lan { # handle 1847
		oifname "br-lan" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump handle_reject comment "!fw4: reject lan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3626
	}

	chain drop_to_lan { # handle 2791
		oifname "br-lan" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "!fw4: drop lan IPv4/IPv6 traffic" # handle 3627
	}
}
